**P2 — Do not enable a known-failing main-branch workflow**

The checked-out SDK still allows suspension to complete before the root handler's `finally` exits, while this suite rejects that behavior. Consequently, this unconditional cloud step will fail on every `main` push until a separate fix lands, leaving the branch permanently red and obscuring unrelated regressions. Land the SDK lifecycle fixes together with this workflow, or keep the cloud step gated/non-blocking until the assertions pass; then enable the local regression tests in PR CI as well.
